messages:
maria: Heads-up — I've been validating a minimal-capability image for runtime nodes. Dropping a few capabilities caused one of our sidecar init containers to fail in staging. Need quick coordination on pruning privileged caps and how that intersects with KMS mounts/audit logs.

maria: Failing log snippet from staging pod: `E init: failed to open /var/run/keystore: permission denied (cap_dac_read_search)`

devon: hmm, which capability was removed? `CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH`?

maria: Yeah. We removed a batch: CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH, CAP_SYS_ADMIN (attempt to be aggressive). Init needs DAC_READ_SEARCH to read legacy keystore files which are mounted from the kms-proxy sidecar.

liam: Why is keystore mounted as a world-unreadable file rather than socket+auth? We should move to a unix socket with auth token so we don't need that cap.

maria: Agreed long-term. Short-term we need a rollout plan — can't break staging -> prod.

anya: Quick questions: 1) Is the kms-proxy using hostPath or CSI? 2) Any RBAC changes needed for the proxy service account?

maria: CSI driver. No new RBAC needed right now but if we change to socket auth we'll need to grant the proxy SA access to the secrets CSI exposes.

devon: For immediate fix, can we grant only CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH to that init container instead of re-adding everything? We can set securityContext.capabilities.add: ["DAC_READ_SEARCH"] in the pod spec.

liam: That works. Also add an explicit seccomp profile to reduce syscall surface rather than relying on broad caps. Example: `securityContext: { seccompProfile: { type: \"RuntimeDefault\" } }`

maria: I'll try that in staging now. Also logging/audit question: when the init container reads the keystore, do we have an audit trail to link which SA pulled keys? We need to meet the compliance SLO for key access events.

devon: The CSI driver emits events to kube-audit and we have a pipeline that forwards to Splunk with a `kms.access` tag. But the read itself (open syscall) isn't currently correlated to the SA identity unless the proxy annotates the request with the SA token subject.

liam: We can add a small middleware in kms-proxy to inject `x-kms-principal: system:serviceaccount:ns:sa-name` from the incoming pod token — easy change. Will add an opt-in flag so we can roll it out safely.

maria: Nice. That solves the audit requirement if we record the principal and request id. Can we also ensure the proxy logs are forwarded with structured JSON so the SIEM picks them up?

anya: Ops question: if we patch the pods to add DAC_READ_SEARCH to init containers, how do we do a canary? We should avoid cluster-wide immediate rollout.

devon: We can add a rollout job that patches a single deployment (staging) via `kubectl patch deploy xyz -p '{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"initContainers\":[{\"name\":\"init-keystore\",\"securityContext\":{\"capabilities\":{\"add\":[\"DAC_READ_SEARCH\"]}}}]}}}}'` then watch for failures for 30m. If green, propagate to a handful of namespaces using a simple script.

maria: I'll run that on staging and post results. If it passes, we'll schedule the canary for prod next Tuesday during the 09:00 window.

liam: Follow-up: we should land the kms-proxy principal header and opt-in flag in a bullet PR, then roll the proxy to staging before changing pods. That way audit correlation is ready.

devon: Also remind infra to rotate the CSI node publish secret after we switch auth modes — keywrap changes might require a KMS key policy update in Vault/HSM.

maria: Good call. Who owns rotation? @devon can you create a short runbook for the rotation steps (Vault policy, HSM key ACL, CI/CD secret update)?

devon: Yep, I'll draft a runbook and drop it in #eng-ops. Will include rollback steps to re-enable the old capability if anything breaks.

liam: For mitigations, add an admission webhook check that fails new pod specs that try to re-add broad caps like SYS_ADMIN. We can whitelist the init container DAC_READ_SEARCH for the keystore init name only.

anya: That admission change should be staged behind a feature flag to avoid surprising teams.

maria: Test results: staging patched, init succeeded, keystore read logged with `x-kms-principal`. No errors in app logs. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: staging -> prod canary at 2026-03-23T09:00Z. Notifying on-call.

maria: Next steps summary: 1) land kms-proxy header PR (liam) 2) secure canary patch for init container caps (maria/devon) 3) draft runbook and KMS rotation notes (devon) 4) create admission webhook feature-flagged rule (liam/anya) 5) monitor and rollback plan (maria).

liam: I'll start the PR for the proxy and the webhook scaffolding. ETA EOD tomorrow.

devon: Runbook draft by EOD today.

anya: I'll coordinate the canary window with SRE and pen test team.

maria: Thanks all — ping me if you see anything odd in staging. :thumbsup:
